mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT product_code AS code_number, product_name FROM stock_data WHERE product_code IS NOT NULL AND product_code <> '' ORDER BY product_code
SELECT DISTINCT product_name, product_code, supplier, specification, category FROM stock_data WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL AND product_name <> '' ORDER BY product_name

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username_cn, ''), u.username) AS name FROM users u JOIN user_sidebar_permissions s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.page_permissions_json LIKE '%"is_shipper":true%' ORDER BY name

SELECT remark_number FROM ( SELECT remark_number, COALESCE(SUM(in_quantity), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(out_quantity), 0) AS net FROM stockinout_data WHERE product_name = #{productName} AND product_remark_checked = 1 AND remark_number IS NOT NULL AND remark_number <> '' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY remark_number HAVING net > 0 ) t ORDER BY remark_number
